```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.align = 'center', out.width = '80%')
options(width = 90)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Delivery <- read.csv("Delivery_v7.csv")
Delivery$Type <- factor(Delivery$Type, levels = c("In-house", "Courier"))
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
by(Delivery$Minutes, Delivery$Type, function(x)
  round(c(n = length(x), mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x), median = median(x),
          min = min(x), max = max(x), se = sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))), 2))
```

## Levene's Test for Equality of Variances

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(car)
leveneTest(y = Delivery$Minutes, group = Delivery$Type, center = mean)
```

## Independent Samples t Tests

```{r}
t.test(Minutes ~ Type, data = Delivery, var.equal = FALSE)
```

```{r}
t.test(Minutes ~ Type, data = Delivery, var.equal = TRUE)
```
